quiz.title: HALLOWEEN SPECIAL
quiz.greeting: Happy Halloween! Dare you face my spooky questions? Press red to begin.
quiz.share: I scored {score}/12 on Halloween Flummox!, the spooky Teletext quiz on STEEVEFAX page 152. Can you flummox Felix?

verdicts.text: Felix is scared stiff! A perfect game.
Not bad. Felix has seen scarier.
Boo! Felix is not flummoxed in the slightest.

questions.question: Halloween grew out of Samhain, a festival from which country?
questions.quip: Right! Samhain marked the end of the harvest and the start of winter.

questions.question: Before pumpkins, what did people in Scotland and Ireland carve into lanterns?
questions.quip: Yes! A neep lantern. Much harder to carve.

questions.question: Who directed the 1978 film Halloween?
questions.quip: Correct! He wrote the music too.

questions.question: Which 1992 BBC drama, shown on Halloween night, fooled viewers into thinking it was real?
questions.quip: Right! Even Michael Parkinson was in on it.

questions.question: Which horror star does the spooky voice-over in Michael Jackson's Thriller?
What is the green ghost in Ghostbusters (1984) called?
questions.quip: Yes! He slimed Venkman in the Sedgewick Hotel.

questions.question: Who wrote Frankenstein?
questions.quip: Correct! She started it at 18, on a stormy holiday by Lake Geneva.

questions.question: Where does Dracula first come ashore in England?
questions.quip: Right! As a large black dog, no less.

questions.question: In ITV's Knightmare, what was the child in the helmet called?
What are The Simpsons' Halloween episodes called?
Anjelica Huston played the Grand High Witch in which 1990 film?
What is the fear of the number 13 called?
questions.quip: Spot on! And this one was question 12. Phew.
